news.title: Hotter-than-expected October CPI knocks Nasdaq lower after Monday's rebound
news.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m headline and 0.3% m/m core - cooler than September on a y/y basis but above consensus - pressuring tech-heavy indices at the open after Monday's 2%+ rally. Yahoo Finance reports the Nasdaq Composite down about 0.8% at the open as the data firmed bets the Fed holds a less dovish line into the 9 Dec FOMC meeting. FMP's own live reads at ~09:42 ET: S&P 500 -0.62%, Dow -0.40%, Russell 2000 -1.03%, VIX +5.3% (prior close basis).

footnotes: QQQ omitted: WebSearch returned no reconciled, dated-today quote (results ranged from stale Nov 5 figures near $647 to undated ~$706 prints) - the no-invent rule means the page carries forward the brief's last confirmed QQQ close rather than publish an unreconciled number.
